Approved with the following conditions:
1. That all window and door repairs and replacements on the historic structure
be performed in-kind, matching original materials, design, and profiles;
2. That any adjustments made to the drawings be submitted to the Development
Services Department prior to the issuance of a Certificate of Appropriateness.

Approved with the following conditions:
1. That the front door configuration reflect a typical front door style and
configuration
that is compatible and consistent with the historic district;
2. That the windows be installed in a way that is compatible with the fenestration
style
in the district i.e. inset with appropriate projecting sills, header and trim and;
3. That any adjustments made to the drawings be submitted to the Development
Services Department prior to the issuance of a Certificate of Appropriateness.

Approved with the following conditions:
1. That the materials used on the front and side facades be all brick to reflect a
consistent material on the streetscape and the guidelines;
2. That a consistent cantilevered awning be placed over the first floor where
possible
to reflect a typical storefront configuration;
3. That a treatment of either brick coursing or stone or similar be placed between
the
first and second floors be installed to reflect a consistent look of a typical two
story
commercial building;
4. That the state historical marker located at the corner of Evans and Terrell be
protected during construction, or, if it needs to be removed, stored with the
County
and reinstalled after the project is complete, and;
5. That any adjustments made to the drawings be submitted to the Development
Services Department prior to the issuance of a Certificate of Appropriateness.
